os-dev-report · 2026-11-04T13:54Z · status **PR ready** · PR #30047 · branch `claude/project-thread-sp3uvb` · head `51f9b29e`

- **Fix:** the console's chat request names the selected app and the page in view. `ChatPane` sends `context.activeApp` as the selected app's package (the new `activeAppPackageId`: the console app the dock sits in, whichever agent runs; else `editPackageId`), and omits it when nothing is selected. The constant `'AI'` is gone. The dock (desktop rail and phone sheet) sends `context.surface` in cloud#1610's existing shape, read off the URL by `consoleChatSurface` (`layout/chatSurfaceContext.ts`) against `APP_ROUTE_METADATA_READS`, ranked like `<Routes>`. Object list: the object. Saved view: object plus `selection {kind:'view'}`. Record page, edit form and named record page: object plus `selection {kind:'record', id}`. Dashboard, report, page: `artifact {type, name}`; the dashboard designer adds `mode:'design'`. Every other page sends no `surface`. The context is read per send: the transport reads `body` through a ref, and the pane is keyed on the conversation, not the page.
- **Tests:** `ChatDock.requestContext-30043.test.tsx` runs the real `ConsoleLayout`, both dock presentations, the real lazy body, the real `ChatPane` and the real `useObjectChat`, and pins the JSON body of the captured POST in 6 cases: record page, list page, build agent, navigation with the dock open, no app selected, phone sheet. With the two source files put back to `origin/main`, all 6 fail on assertions; restored, all 6 pass. `chatSurfaceContext-30043.test.ts` has 8 mapping cases. The `useObjectChat.transportIdentity` fixture no longer models `activeApp: 'AI'`.
- **Local:** 65 neighbouring files (dock, ConsoleLayout, console/ai, Studio copilot), 368 tests, all pass. Derived gates: 36/36 pass. The `ui scripts/` family was red at first only because of a no-DTS spec build in this container; after a real spec build, 170 files and 4,985 tests pass. `app-shell` type-check was NOT MEASURED locally because the `@object-ui/*` declaration closure is unbuilt; `Type Check UI` is green in CI.
- **CI on `51f9b29e`:** CI, Lint & Type Check, Governed Surface Guard, PR-Body Guards and PR Automation are all success: Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI 16/16, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Test Core. The opt-in jobs were skipped.
- **Deviations:**
  - Lint UI on `91f9a655` was red because the new test loaded a module inside `beforeAll` (ui lint rule `no-dynamic-import-in-test-hook`). Fixed in `00eda306`.
  - No workflow ran on `00eda306`: 0 check-runs and 0 workflow runs for that sha, because the session-token push fired no `synchronize`. The branch was brought up to date through the relay's `pr_update_branch` (a clean merge of main `3a272086`, with no overlap with the touched paths), which ran CI on `51f9b29e`.
  - The PR body says `Part of #30043`, not `Closes`, because the card has no `Claim:` naming this branch and the closing-target guard would refuse a closing keyword.
  - No assignee was written.
- **Conflict in the card (not silently resolved):** Do 2 asks for "object + record id + record name", and also for "the existing cloud#1610 shape, no second one". That shape has no slot for a name: `selection` is `{kind, id}`, and cloud's `sanitizeSurfaceContext` drops any other key. The dock also has no race-free source for a name: `NavigationContext.recordTitle` is unkeyed, and `RecordDetailView` keeps the previous record's title until the next record loads. The id is sent; the name is not. Sending the name would need a spec key (e.g. `selection.label`) plus a title channel keyed by record id. That is the seat's ruling.
- **For cloud#3564's half (`carrier: cloud`):** the agent route reads `appName`, `objectName`, `recordId`, `viewName`, `surface` and `packageId`, and not `activeApp`. The prompt block names only `surface.pillar`, `surface.artifact` and `surface.mode`, not `surface.selection`, so a record id in `selection` reaches the tool context but not the prompt text until cloud reads it.
- **Out of scope:** none filed.
- **security_findings:** withheld: none.
- **api_writes:** 3 relay strokes on objectstack (`pr_create` #30047, `pr_update_branch`, `pr_ready`) plus this comment; `git push` ×5. **mcp_calls:** reads only.
- **Dedupe words:** `dock activeApp surface`, `chat request context record`, `consoleChatSurface`.

Closing. The fix is objectstack#30047, merged after seat 2's ACCEPT. The console AI dock now sends:
- the selected app's package as `context.activeApp` (never `'AI'`);
- the page in view as `context.surface`, in cloud#1610's shape.

cloud#3568 reads both. Ruling on the record name: it is not sent, because the server reads the record by id as the user.

Still owed: cloud needs a pin round that carries this PR (together with objectstack#30058). The staging 10/10 read happens after that, on maintainer card cloud#3342.
